title: My English Class
sentences: I go to an English class every Tuesday evening.
The class starts at six and finishes at eight.
There are twelve students in my group.
Most of us work during the day, so we are often tired.
Our teacher is patient and speaks slowly.
We practise speaking in pairs for the first half hour.
Then we read a short text and answer questions about it.
I write new words in a small notebook every week.
At home I read them again before I go to sleep.
My listening is still weak, but it is getting better.
